policies.text: A firm is selected for extended route dispatch if it holds preferred vendor standing and maintains a liability insurance coverage of at least 5 million USD.
A shuttle operator attains fleet economy targets by logging an annual fuel efficiency of at least 12 miles per gallon last year.
A warehousing business obtains cold storage endorsement by maintaining indoor temperature below two degrees.
A provider is approved for corporate transport contracts if that provider maintains quality management clearance.
A passenger carrier earns driver proficiency endorsement when maintaining a driver training index of at least 85 percent.
A carrier receives quality management clearance when holding an active ISO 9001 quality certification.
A transport contractor obtains premier logistics provider status if it meets basic operational criteria and is selected for extended route dispatch.
A freight agency meets workforce capacity standards by maintaining at least 40 certified logistics specialists.

A transport vendor achieves top-tier safety standing either by completing at least 10 safety audits last year alongside maintaining a fleet size of at least 20 vehicles and securing a customer satisfaction rating of 85 percent or higher, or by holding a Gold Fleet Safety Award.
An airline meets flight performance standards either by achieving an on-time arrival rate of at least 90 percent this quarter or by holding an IATA Operational Safety Audit certification.
A rail freight operator secures heavy hauling permits when running locomotives with zero carbon emissions.
An airline is assigned prime flight windows provided it maintains valid flight authorization.
A travel company secures travel provider endorsement upon holding a Certified Tour Operator badge.
An air carrier maintains valid flight authorization when it meets flight performance standards and maintains an active hangar maintenance agreement.
A firm meets basic operational criteria either by recording an annual revenue of at least 10 million USD last year or by holding a Class A Transport Licence.
A provider is designated for VIP shuttle operations if that provider earns driver proficiency endorsement.
An enterprise achieves preferred vendor standing when it is granted priority route dispatch.
A carrier earns priority route dispatch provided it maintains top-tier safety standing and is approved for enterprise service agreements.
A charter firm obtains commercial flight operator approval when holding an FAA Part 135 Air Carrier Certificate.
